title: Allow Lock/Logout widget button spacing to match other widgets like the system tray
line: Lock/Logout buttons in a panel are now spaced like System Tray icons instead of sitting closer together.
explanation: In a panel, the Lock/Logout widget gave each button a square cell exactly as long as the panel is thick, with no spacing, and the icon filled it. The System Tray instead uses a standard rounded icon size plus two smallSpacing units per cell, so on a default 44 px panel tray icons were 30 px apart and Lock/Logout buttons 28 px, and on thicker panels the Lock/Logout icons almost touched. Each button's cell along the panel is now the rounded icon size for the panel thickness plus the same 2 × smallSpacing the tray uses, so both widgets line up with identical spacing.

commits.message:
applets/lock_logout: space buttons like System Tray icons in panels

In a panel each button took a square as thick as the panel, so the icons
sat closer together than the System Tray's and almost touched on thicker
panels. Give each button the same icon size plus spacing as a tray cell.

BUG: 515693

review.text: Using roundedIconSize(min(buttonThickness, enormous)) + 2 * smallSpacing for each button cell cleanly aligns Lock/Logout panel button spacing with System Tray's default Normal spacing without introducing unnecessary configuration options. The QML layout bindings have no binding loops, preserve desktop/vertical/stacked behavior, and fix icons nearly touching on thicker panels. Before/after screenshots across 44 px, 64 px, and vertical panels clearly confirm the fix.

reviews.text: Using roundedIconSize(min(buttonThickness, enormous)) + 2 * smallSpacing for each button cell cleanly aligns Lock/Logout panel button spacing with System Tray's default Normal spacing without introducing unnecessary configuration options. The QML layout bindings have no binding loops, preserve desktop/vertical/stacked behavior, and fix icons nearly touching on thicker panels. Before/after screenshots across 44 px, 64 px, and vertical panels clearly confirm the fix.

Small, targeted change in the right place: in horizontal/vertical panels each button cell becomes roundedIconSize(thickness) + 2×smallSpacing, the same spacing the System Tray uses by default, so the reporter's expected result (same distances as the tray) holds out of the box; screenshots on 44 px, 64 px and vertical panels show matching gaps. The stacked-buttons branch and desktop placement are untouched, and icon rendering stays the same. Not mirroring the tray's Small/Large spacing setting is a reasonable scope decision for this request. Nit: the explanation says the tray uses a rounded icon size per cell, but by default it uses the fixed small icon size; only the 2×smallSpacing part is shared.
